title: Maple Route driver gives an arrival window
caller_intent: Say a package arrives today between 4 and 6pm

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is Chris Nguyen, a driver with Maple Route Delivery. I have a package for Alex Kim.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: This is an AI assistant for Alex Kim, and this call may be recorded. What should I pass along?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'll be in the neighborhood today between 4 and 6pm. I don't need a signature if the lobby is open.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll tell Alex about the 4 to 6 window. Do you need anything else?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No fee, no link, and no card. If a gate code would be required, I can leave the package at the front desk instead.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No payment and no code needed. Anything else for the message?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That's the whole message. The package arrives today between 4 and 6. If the time is bad, Alex can call Maple Route's main desk at 206-555-0160.
